alkylation_concentration.evidence: Lysates were then cleared by centrifugation, and proteins alkylated by the addition of 10mM iodoacetamide for 30min at RT in the dark.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Lysates were then cleared by centrifugation, and proteins alkylated by the addition of 10mM iodoacetamide for 30min at RT in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteolytic cleavage was then performed by the addition of Lys-C in a 1:50 enzyme to substrate and incubation at 37C overnight with agitation.

collision_energy.evidence: Ions with a charge state of 2-5 were isolated using a 0.7 m/z window and fragmented using HCD with a normalized collision energy of 32% and dynamic exclusion within a 10 ppm range for 30 seconds to prevent repeat sequencing.
Ions with a charge state >1 were isolated using a 2.2 m/z window and fragmented using HCD with a normalized collision energy of 27% and an automatic dynamic exclusion.

enrichment_method.evidence: Next, the dried peptides were enriched for phosphorylated peptides by incubation with Ni-NTA Superflow beads (Qiagen cat. no. 30210) that had been stripped with EDTA and loaded with iron chloride.
For mass spectrometry, cells were scraped and pelleted for biotin/streptavidin precipitation as previously described.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: MS1 scans were taken at a resolution of 120,000 with a maximum injection time of 50 ms and a normalized AGC target of 250% over a scan range of 350-1350 m/z.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Raw files were searched in MaxQuant using label free quantitation with match between runs against the reviewed human proteome including isoforms, downloaded from Uniprot on October 22, 2020.
